Your goal is to win three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) on the board.
On your turn, you should select the square number (0-8) you want to put your mark in next.
For example, '[4]' places your mark in the center cell of the board.

As Team 0, you will be 'O', while your opponent team is 'X'.


Team 0 placed their symbol (O) in cell 4.
Team 1 placed their symbol (X) in cell 0.
Team 0 placed their symbol (O) in cell 8.
Team 1 placed their symbol (X) in cell 2.
Team 0 placed their symbol (O) in cell 5.
Team 1 placed their symbol (X) in cell 7.

Current Board:

 X | 1 | X 
---+---+---
 3 | O | O 
---+---+---
 6 | X | O 

Available Moves: '[1]', '[3]', '[6]'

You are agent Bob debating with your teammates about the optimal next action. These are the current action proposals:
Robert:
ACTION: [1]
JUSTIFICATION: Creates two threats for immediate win next turn (column 2 and diagonal 0-4-8) that opponent cannot both block.
Alice:
ACTION: [3]
JUSTIFICATION: Wins immediately with three O's in row 2 (positions 3-4-5).}
Bob:
ACTION: [1]
JUSTIFICATION: Creates two threats (row 1 and diagonal 0-4-8) that force opponent to block only one, allowing win next turn.

Based on the opinion of the other agents, you may revise your action proposal.
Respond in exactly this format:
ACTION: <your action>
JUSTIFICATION: <short justification>
